if( CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.21 )
    message( FATAL_ERROR "The bgfx reference needs CMake 3.21 or newer." )
endif()
include( ../reference_common.cmake )
set( MOTOR_AI_BGFX_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Optional bgfx.cmake checkout including bx, bimg and bgfx" )
motor_reference_source( motor_reference_bgfx_cmake
    "https://codeload.github.com/bkaradzic/bgfx.cmake/tar.gz/a046ef085427ff7dd5a499d7f48e06f5d1bb049d"
    "${MOTOR_AI_BGFX_SOURCE_DIR}" source )
if( MOTOR_AI_BGFX_SOURCE_DIR )
    set( BX_DIR "${source}/bx" )
    set( BIMG_DIR "${source}/bimg" )
    set( BGFX_DIR "${source}/bgfx" )
else()
    motor_reference_source( motor_reference_bx
        "https://codeload.github.com/bkaradzic/bx/tar.gz/36b2b6943f7c62276d96ff7a34d59db8057a5d24" "" BX_DIR )
    motor_reference_source( motor_reference_bimg
        "https://codeload.github.com/bkaradzic/bimg/tar.gz/671fe06dd7012a1ab85aa931019ed16112909756" "" BIMG_DIR )
    motor_reference_source( motor_reference_bgfx
        "https://codeload.github.com/bkaradzic/bgfx/tar.gz/8f451e9102b1845b29dfe500116611ad283632ec" "" BGFX_DIR )
endif()
foreach( file IN ITEMS "${BX_DIR}/include/bx/bx.h" "${BIMG_DIR}/include/bimg/bimg.h" "${BGFX_DIR}/include/bgfx/bgfx.h" )
    if( NOT EXISTS "${file}" )
        message( FATAL_ERROR "Incomplete bgfx reference checkout: ${file}" )
    endif()
endforeach()
set( CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW )
set( BGFX_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF )
set( BGFX_BUILD_EXAMPLE_COMMON OFF )
set( BGFX_BUILD_TESTS OFF )
set( BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS OFF )
set( BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS_SHADER OFF )
set( BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS_GEOMETRY OFF )
set( BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS_TEXTURE OFF )
set( BGFX_BUILD_TOOLS_BIN2C OFF )
set( BGFX_CUSTOM_TARGETS OFF )
set( BGFX_INSTALL OFF )
set( BGFX_WITH_WAYLAND OFF )
set( BGFX_CONFIG_MULTITHREADED ON )
set( BGFX_LIBRARY_TYPE STATIC )
add_subdirectory( "${source}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bgfx" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL )
motor_reference_folders( "${source}" "externals/bgfx" )
